corrections.before: The wizard has five steps: Welcome, Authentication, Business-user portal, Outbound email, Invite your team. Organization identity and module settings are configured afterward in Settings.
corrections.after: The wizard has nine steps: Welcome to OpenLaw, Your organization, Authentication, Business-user portal, Outbound email, Invite your team, E-signature, AI analysis, Review, shown as Step N of 9. Setup cannot finish without working outbound email. Have an authenticator app ready if two-factor authentication will be required.

corrections.after: Your organization: Organization name, Upload (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG under 256 KB), Default locale with only English (United States), Default timezone; Continue saves.

corrections.before: Keep Built-in sign-in or select Single sign-on (OIDC); register the provider and copy its callback URL.
corrections.after: Switches Email and password, Email magic link, Single sign-on (SSO), Require two-factor authentication for Administrators and Legal Team Members. At least one method is required. The SSO switch is unavailable until Register your identity provider / Register provider succeeds; copy the shown callback URL. Turning on two-factor and selecting Continue forces two-factor setup, after which the wizard reopens at Welcome.
